adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, the sync branch returns the raw `fetch(...)` `Response` without checking status or parsing JSON. In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the caller assumes the returned value has a `.data` field (`const token = res?.data;`), which is true for the non-sync branch (`myGoogleAuth.refreshToken(...).res`) but false for a `fetch` `Response`. That makes `token` undefined and will trigger errors when accessing `token.access_token`/`token.expiry_date`, with no verification of `response.ok` in the sync path. This is a concrete type/behavior mismatch introduced by the diff and can break token refresh when the sync endpoint is enabled.
